v001_reference: src/research/opportunity_scout/providers.py QUESTIONS (five choice questions) and shadow_request; neither is edited by this proposal.
purpose: Atomic questions that map one-to-one onto AI Critic V001 hard dimensions, so Jev can be tested as an inexpensive screener and disagreement detector against independent human anchors.
request_format: System One request: model, state, questions; each question type choice with criteria yes, no and unsure, as in V001.
model: UNRESOLVED: V001 pins jev-1.13.0. Account availability and live response compatibility remain unverified until an owner-authorised call.

predictor_observable_before_outcome.instructions: Using only the card's own timing definitions, could the predictor be observed or recorded before the outcome is realised? If the timing is not stated, choose unsure.

criteria.yes: The stated predictor timing precedes the stated outcome timing.
criteria.no: By its own definitions the predictor is only observable after the outcome, or is built from outcome-period data.

outcome_independent_of_predictor.instructions: Is the outcome defined and measured independently of the predictor, rather than being the predictor itself, a transformation of it, or definitionally implied by it?

criteria.no: The outcome restates or mechanically follows from the predictor.
criteria.unsure: The definitions are too vague to tell.

falsifier_discriminates_alternative.instructions: Would the stated falsifying observation count against this mechanism but not equally against the card's own stated main uncertainty or competing explanation?

criteria.yes: The falsifier separates the mechanism from the alternative.
criteria.no: The falsifier would occur under the alternative too, or absorbs every outcome.
criteria.unsure: No alternative is stated, or the falsifier is ambiguous.

causal_chain_complete.instructions: Does each of the four causal links state how its earlier stage produces its later stage, without a missing or contradictory step?

criteria.yes: Every link states a channel and no step contradicts another.
criteria.no: A step is missing, unexplained or contradicts another.
criteria.unsure: A link depends on an institutional fact not supplied.

duplicate_of_reference.instructions: Given only the supplied reference mechanisms, does the card restate one of them (same trigger, transmission, affected party and consequence) in different words?

criteria.no: Its mechanism differs materially from every reference item.
criteria.unsure: The reference set is empty or too ambiguous.

not_asked: Jev is never asked whether an idea is novel without the frozen reference set, or whether it is profitable.
evaluation_design: See docs/opportunity_scout/ai_critic_v001_calibration_protocol.md section 'Choosing a Jev role'. Run V001 and V002 on the same blinded cards only after the owner authorises both instruments; compare each against independent human anchors, never against the AI critics alone.
activation_requires: an owner decision adopting this instrument as a new frozen version, with its exact request bytes and hash
the separately documented per-payload Jev authorisation (disclosure consent, cost ceiling, model pin, one request per payload, no retry on content)
independent human anchors frozen before any Jev answer is viewed
